setup: Sit tall on the floor in a wide straddle (pancake) position with your knees straight and toes pointing upward.
If tight hamstrings prevent an upright pelvis, sit on the edge of a yoga block or mat to elevate your hips.
Interlace your fingers lightly behind your head with elbows held wide, keeping your chest tall and spine extended.
steps: Hinge forward from the hips, actively tilting your pelvis forward while maintaining a flat, neutral spine.
Lower your chest toward the floor between your legs until you feel an intense stretch in your adductors and hamstrings without rounding your lower back.
Pause momentarily at end range, then contract your glutes and lower back muscles to return smoothly to the upright seated position.
instructions.breathing: Inhale deeply as you hinge forward toward the floor; exhale as you pull yourself back up to the seated upright position.
cues: Rotate the pelvis, don't round the back
Knees locked and toes to the ceiling

common_faults.fault: Rounding the lumbar spine to reach the floor rather than hinging from the hips.
common_faults.correction: Elevate the hips on a block and limit the range of motion to only what can be achieved with a flat back and anterior pelvic tilt.

common_faults.fault: Allowing the knees to bend or the feet to roll inward.
common_faults.correction: Actively flex your quadriceps to keep your knees locked and pull your toes backward while pointing your kneecaps straight up.

precautions: Move smoothly into the stretch and avoid ballistic bouncing to prevent adductor or hamstring strains.

name: Pancake Good Morning
summary: A seated hip-hinge mobility exercise performed in a wide straddle to develop active hamstring and adductor flexibility alongside posterior chain strength.
